classification: isolated synthetic CPU development; new prospective disjoint action-consequence evidence, not native Yggdrasil training or protected scientific first-use
source_basis: ENERGY-25 known five-bit interventions and unknown signed three-parent parity causes; this followup uses a new protocol namespace and nonoverlapping primary seeds
hypothesis: Project a learned cubic energy onto its strongest three-way causal factor to remove spurious lower-order correlations in held intervention prediction. This may improve unprojected ridge reliability but must beat equally trained conventional and robust exact Bayes controls to establish a distinctive improvement.
parents: all ten 3-of-5 parent triples with both signs; twenty worlds per seed
source_actions: all 32 possible 5-bit interventions; first sixteen by independent protocol-v1 SHA256 hash become training, remaining sixteen untouched held cases; noise flips chosen by separate SHA256 ranking of the public training action identifiers; noise count is evaluator-side and is NOT exposed as per-world information to learners
strong_controls: Capacity-matched projected conventional uses the identical feature family and fit objective; exact Bayes integrates over all 20 candidate signed triples with Beta(1,4) unknown noise and uniform structure prior, plus a fixed-epsilon 5% Bayes control. All arms receive identical public interventional observations. No true parent/sign metadata is exposed.
frozen_threshold: projected-energy held accuracy >=95% at zero corruption, >=85% at each 2/4 corrupted-label stratum, and >=2 percentage points better than exact unknown-noise Beta-Bayes in *all* three strata; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. If capacity-matched conventional ties, distinctiveness is NO_GO irrespective of other metrics. No native or scientific promotion from this synthetic trial.
negative_controls: Original cubic ridge predictions retained unchanged
Exact Bayesian structure posterior trained on same observed actions
Noisy outcomes and held truth generated from source and independently rederived in audit
Source split and noise domains distinct from ENERGY-25
No held outcomes ever used for fitting/selection
Measure full fit+prediction CPU wall and report weak/strong baselines
